title: Technology!
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Synth lead, arp, pad, crystal bells and electronic percussion -- active without being martial. It is the only piece in the library with high energy AND positive valence, which is precisely the corner nothing else occupies: a country that is busy and doing well. That is why it wins a research push and a growing empire but loses every war to Bombing Voronezh, whose energy it nearly matches but whose valence it does not.
